answer: Require every submitted deliverable to carry an atlas of its own making: a hash-chained lineage of dated drafts, notes and revisions, like rings on a willow, each step stamped as it happens. Auditors spot-check random jobs and demand the intermediate chain; a finished text with no believable history is rejected and the bond burns. A Sybil farm can mass-produce finished outputs, but faking a glacier-slow, per-identity trail of genuine revisions costs real sequential labor for every fake, so scale collapses.
